title: Files on Amazon S3 or a local disk: destination

url.title: URL
url.description: Where the tables go: s3://bucket/prefix, or file:// and an absolute path. Each stream's table is a directory of files under it.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: An S3-compatible store's endpoint, such as MinIO's, Cloudflare R2's or SeaweedFS's, with path-style addressing. Empty for Amazon S3. Not for file:// URLs.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key. Without one, the AWS default credentials.

format.title: Format
format.description: The files' format: Parquet, CSV with a header line, or JSON Lines. From 0.2.0.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Parquet: zstd (the default), snappy, gzip or none, inside the file. CSV and JSON Lines, from 0.2.0: gzip, zstd or none (the default), the whole file, which gets the extension .gz or .zst.

fileSize.title: File size
fileSize.description: Bytes a file reaches, compressed, before the next one starts: at least 1 MiB and, from 0.2.0, at most 4 GiB, as Commit copies each file into place and S3 copies at most 5 GiB at once.

x-groups.title: Location
x-groups.description: Where the files are, and the address of the store's API.

x-groups.title: Files
x-groups.description: How each table's files are written.
